summary: Day of Defeat entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Day of Defeat
entries.definitive_edition: Steam GoldSrc Day of Defeat for the original route; Source separately

primary.why: Day of Defeat is the 2003 standalone Valve/GoldSrc release descended from the Half-Life mod. Day of Defeat: Source is a later remake with changed presentation and design, so the original Steam version is the main route for this entry.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam version. Record build, server/bot/community setup, config, resolution, input, and whether Day of Defeat: Source was compared separately.

secondary.exclusive_content: Source-engine remake with changed graphics, physics, maps, and design feel
secondary.what_to_play: Use separately only for remake comparison.
secondary.why: It is not the same GoldSrc artifact.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record server/community state and keep Source remake comparison separate.

entries.title: Day of Defeat: Source
entries.definitive_edition: Current Steam Day of Defeat: Source build, with server/map/mod state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current Steam Source build on active/community server

primary.why: Day of Defeat: Source is a Source-engine remake/rework rather than just a patch of the original GoldSrc Day of Defeat. The PC Steam build is the only meaningful current route, but archive completeness depends on server population, map rotation, mods, and bot/community-server state.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam build. Record OS, build, graphics settings, server, map, class, player count or bots, mod/custom-content state, Steam networking state, and whether original Day of Defeat was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use the existing original Day of Defeat entry for the GoldSrc route.
secondary.why: Source is a distinct remake/rework and should not replace the original.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with the original Day of Defeat entry. Record server and custom content because this is a multiplayer-first archive target.
